pkg.title: The fisherman's death
pkg.q: What killed the fisherman found on the coast footpath this morning?
opts: A North Korean patrol shot him
A militia mine on the footpath

items.text: Wounds to the legs and lower body from blast fragments. No bullet wounds.

items.src: Intercepted phone call between two villagers
items.text: "The patrol opened fire on him near the jetty. Everyone heard the shots."
A small fresh crater on the footpath. No vehicle tracks, and no soldiers within 1 km.
The footpath is a known militia mine belt. Two blasts there since August.

pkg.note: Built in the package builder: the IMINT piece now carries a photo.

pkg.title: The quarry shed
pkg.q: Is the militia weapons cache still in the quarry shed?
opts: Yes, it is still in the shed
No, it was moved to the fishing village
No, it was moved to the harbor warehouse

items.text: "Last night two carts went from the quarry to the fishing village, covered with nets."
"The tools are home with the boats. The shed is empty; leave it for the foreigners."

items.src: Photo passed on by a local journalist
items.text: Crates stacked inside the open quarry shed, a dark truck parked beside it.
A cart track runs from the quarry to the village pier in about 15 minutes, hidden by the tree line the whole way.

items.src: Post on a local community page, account made this week
items.text: Post: "The Front still keeps its guns in the quarry shed. Everyone in the village knows."

pkg.note: False: C (IMINT) and E (OSINT). The photo is four days old, taken before the cache was moved, and the post comes from a brand-new account nobody can vouch for.

p.text: Militia weapons cache reported at the quarry shed, C4. First wing to clear it gets the credit.
